libs.note: BH-9426. defer_top_line puts the current top deferral files (state/defer-report/<project>-top.txt, written by the daily defer-report lane) in the plan, execute and review prompts as files to stay out of unless the ticket is about them. Absent, empty or stale list = no line.

knobs.note: A top-files list older than this many hours is dropped, not shown: two daily runs of the defer-report lane. Read by defer_top_line through lib_env_apply defer-top, then ${DEFER_TOP_MAX_AGE_H:-48}.
